notes: This is a Wix-based website that requires JavaScript rendering (Playwright/Selenium). The static HTML contains no listing data - all content is loaded dynamically via JavaScript. The page structure shows typical Wix components with data loaded from Wix APIs. To scrape this site, you would need to: 1) Use Playwright or Selenium to render JavaScript, 2) Wait for the gallery/listing elements to load, 3) Look for selectors like [data-testid='gallery-item'], .wixui-gallery__item, or similar Wix gallery components once JS renders. The page appears to use Wix's native gallery or repeater components for displaying listings. Alternative approach: Investigate Wix's data APIs or check browser network tab for API endpoints that could be called directly.
